_meta.title: Video Color Palette (one-fit LUT regrade)
_meta.description: Regrade a clip to a palette (hex colours / preset) or to a reference still, flicker-free. No models: a single CJVideoPalette node (comfy_nodes/cj_h3_tools/cj_video_palette.py, numpy + ffmpeg) samples frames across the clip, fits ONE OKLab colour transform (mean + covariance transfer, soft nearest-swatch pull for palettes), bakes it with strength / keep-luminance / skin protection into a 33^3 LUT, applies that LUT to every frame and muxes the source audio (H.264 + AAC MP4). The LUT is also written as a .cube next to the MP4. The builder (src/lib/oj/videoPalette.ts) fills video / reference / palette / strength.
